idea-plugin.name: JS Licence Key Gate
idea-plugin.description:
Handsontable, TinyMCE, CKEditor 5, FullCalendar, AG Grid, MUI X and Syncfusion licence keys in closed-source JS/TS

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → JS Licence Key Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 15 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/js-licence-key-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/js-licence-key-gate

action.text: JS Licence Key Gate: Check This File
action.description: Run JS Licence Key Gate on the file in the editor
